run_hierarchical_sampling: run hierarchical sampling on a clustering dataset to select a target number of balanced data points
run_with_random_strategy: run the sampling script with random strategy to select images from hierarchical clusters
run_with_closest_strategy: run the sampling script with closest strategy to pick nearest images to cluster centroids
run_with_valid_indices: run hierarchical sampling filtered by a valid indices numpy file to restrict the dataset
run_and_save_indices: run hierarchical sampling and save the selected indices as a numpy array to disk
